name: mdpm-monorepo
description: Markdown-based project & task management that lives in your repo

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode --noEmit
scripts.install-extension: npm run package -w mdpm-vscode && code --install-extension packages/vscode/mdpm-vscode.vsix --force
